title: Each essay has its own semantic context (2026-11-04)

sections.name: narrative
sections.content:
The scenario for the editor in time: 

Each essay has it's own semantic context. If I'm writing a contract, I am probably not working with problems and claims. 

If I'm writing a story, my background will be characters, events, places. 

If I am writing product marketing text, I may need other background elements.
